payload.friendly_name: Issue-Matrix Partition Read Integrity & Merge Verdict-Terminality
payload.purpose_context: On coordination-topology missions the authored issue-matrix verdicts live on the coordination branch, but several gates read the primary working-tree copy (stale residue): mission-review reports a false hard FAIL (#5171) and the merge gate finds nothing to enforce and lands a false PASS (#4943). Separately, merge records work packages done without applying the in-mission -> done terminal-verdict rule that only move-task enforces, so a mission can land with an unresolved verdict on record (#4943, second leg). This mission closes the partition-resolution class at every consumer and makes merge honor terminal verdicts, so the mission ledger a team relies on is trustworthy.
payload.purpose_tldr: Make issue-matrix gates resolve the coordination partition (and the coord branch ref post-consolidation) so coord-topology missions stop getting false review FAILs and false merge PASSes, and make merge enforce terminal issue verdicts.

options: Fold #5171 review-gate and #4943 merge-gate partition legs
payload.question: What partition-resolution scope should this mission cover?

payload.final_answer: Fold #5171 review-gate and #4943 merge-gate partition legs into one mission, using the status/doctor.py check_issue_matrix two-partition split as the canonical pattern.

options: Deep: read the coordination branch ref when the worktree is unmaterialized
payload.question: How deep should the coordination-partition read fix go?

payload.final_answer: Deep: resolve coord-partition artifacts (issue-matrix) from the coordination branch ref when the worktree is unmaterialized post-consolidation, so review and merge read authored verdicts correctly even after teardown.

payload.question: How to handle #4943's second leg (merge records done bypassing the in-mission->done terminal-verdict rule)?

payload.final_answer: Fold into this mission: merge must apply the same terminal-verdict rule move-task applies, refusing (block) or warning when a gating row is still in-mission/unknown before the target advances.
